heading: Cyber mission forces: program elements

tree.heading: Budget Justification Display.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense shall submit to Congress, as a part of the defense budget materials for fiscal year 2021 and each fiscal year thereafter, a budget justification display, in electronic and print formats, that includes—

children.text: a major force program category for the five-year defense plan of the Department of Defense for the training, manning, and equipping of the cyber mission forces and the cyberspace operations forces; and
program elements for the cyber mission forces and the cyberspace operations forces.

tree.heading: Waiver.—
tree.text: The Secretary may waive the requirement under subsection (a) for fiscal year 2021 if the Secretary—

children.text: determines the Secretary is unable to comply with such requirement for fiscal year 2021; and
establishes a plan to implement the requirement for fiscal year 2022.

tree.heading: Submission.—
tree.text: The Secretary shall provide the displays described in subsection (a)—

children.text: in electronic format not later than five days after the submission by the President under section 1105(a) of title 31 of the budget; and
in print format not later than 21 days after the submission by the President under section 1105(a) of title 31 of the budget.
